transactions.sql: SELECT `hash`, block_number, block_timestamp, block_hash, transaction_index, receipt_gas_used, receipt_contract_address FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_ethereum.transactions` WHERE block_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP('2026-05-31') AND block_timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2026-07-01') AND (lower(from_address) IN UNNEST(@labeled) OR lower(to_address) IN UNNEST(@labeled) OR MOD(ABS(FARM_FINGERPRINT(`hash`)), 100) = 0)

blocks.sql: SELECT number, `hash`, base_fee_per_gas FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_ethereum.blocks` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP('2026-05-31') AND timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2026-07-01')

contracts.sql: SELECT address, is_erc20, is_erc721, block_timestamp, block_number, block_hash FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_ethereum.contracts` WHERE block_timestamp < TIMESTAMP('2026-07-01') AND lower(address) IN UNNEST(@addresses)

amended_tokens.sql: SELECT address, symbol, name, decimals FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_ethereum.amended_tokens`
